title: Slice tangent-plane algebra: range L ∩ g^⊥ = L(ker ℓ), and g = 0 ⇔ ℓ = 0, when ⟨g, L·⟩ = ℓ and g ∈ range L
statement: Let m, P ∈ ℕ, let L : ℝ^m → ℝ^P and ℓ : ℝ^m → ℝ be continuous linear maps (ℝ^k = Euclid k), and let g ∈ ℝ^P satisfy g ∈ L(ℝ^m) and ⟨g, L e⟩ = ℓ(e) for every e ∈ ℝ^m. Then (a) g = 0 if and only if ℓ = 0, and (b) L(ℝ^m) ∩ g^⊥ = L(ker ℓ), where g^⊥ = (ℝ∙g)ᗮ = {v ∈ ℝ^P : ⟨g, v⟩ = 0}; in Lean: LinearMap.range L ⊓ (ℝ ∙ g)ᗮ = Submodule.map L (LinearMap.ker ℓ).
lean_statement: ∀ (m P : ℕ) (L : Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (ℓ : Euclid m →L[ℝ] ℝ) (g : Euclid P), g ∈ LinearMap.range (L : Euclid m →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) → (∀ e : Euclid m, inner ℝ g (L e) = ℓ e) → (g = 0 ↔ ℓ = 0) ∧ LinearMap.range (L : Euclid m →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) ⊓ (ℝ ∙ g)ᗮ = Submodule.map (L : Euclid m →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) (LinearMap.ker (ℓ : Euclid m →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ))
